Aare–Ware Coastal Drive

Five petrol cars, a naked bike and a winding Konkan coast road, with the Hatkhamba junction, a 2 km ghat climb with seven hairpins, a straight Station Road to the Ratnagiri railway station, and rain on demand. Drive solo or bring friends into a room.

Sound turns into a phone call when voice is on?

That is a Bluetooth headset: the moment any app uses its microphone, Windows switches the whole headset to phone mode (mono, low quality), so the game sounds tinny too. It happens in every browser game and call app, not on a server.

Fix: choose your laptop or a USB microphone in the list above (the headset keeps stereo), or join with Listen only.

Also in Windows: Sound settings, More sound settings, Communications tab, set it to Do nothing. Otherwise Windows turns other sounds down while you talk.

A stylised, procedural interpretation of the Aare–Ware coast, not a surveyed map. Sound on for the engine.
